These awesome pet skins are perfect for roleplaying and just hanging out!
* 24 epic pet skins!

Teen Demons is back and this time even spookier! Haunt your friends with these fiendishly amazing skins!

- 12 Skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Gangsters vs Candies
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Whose side will you take? That of the tough and rowdy gangsters or that of the sweet and gentle candies? The choice is yours to make with the Gangsters VS Candies skin pack!

- 8 stunning skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: TV Heads
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Be mindful of watching too much TV or you might end up as a TV-Head!
Dive into the screen and join the TV Heads on their wacky and fantastical adventures!

- 8 Skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Bees Paradise
items.creator: MobBlocks
items.description: Explore this wonderful village and start your adventure in a cosy cottage. Make friends with buzzy bees and make lots of honey. The perfect survival spawn for a Minecraft player.

items.title: Solus Keep
items.creator: Diluvian
items.description:
Solus Keep, a village where you can find a beautiful port and huge farms! Several houses for you to explore and live in and collect resources for your survival on this map!

+ Incredibly detailed with lots of features!
+ An incredible port!

items.title: Element Masters
items.creator: UnderBlocks Studios
items.description:
The Element Masters have arrived, dominating different elements, their powers are impressive! What are you waiting to acquire these amazing skins? 

-11 Different Element Masters
-1 Free Element Masters 
-by UnderBlocks

items.title: Upside Down Teens
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Confuse your friends (and mobs) as you play on your head!

- 6 flipped HD skins
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from The Pocalypse Studios.

items.title: Emotions
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Express your emotions to everyone using these skins! Emotions include 10 different unique skins to show a variety of emotions from happy, sad, nervous, etc! 

- Includes 10 skins!
- Show off your emotions!
- Great for roleplay!
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from 5 Frame Studios.

items.title: TNT Teens
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Play as one of these teen skins with a crazy TNT fashion style. But do not risk getting in contact with fire... you never know if you would just blow up!

- 12 TNT-themed skins 
- 1 free skin
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from Levelatics.

items.title: Cute Kitty HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
Everybody wants to be a cat and you can too! Be a sweet kitty dressed up in some of the cutest fashion. Skyblock, frog, astronaut, dinosaur, and duckie costumes included.

+ 10 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Shadow Demons
items.creator: Tetrascape
items.description:
The brighter the sun the darker the shadows.
8 skins | Created by Tetrascape

items.title: Ninja Robbers
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Hi-YAH! Ninja Robbers is great for getting around sneaky situations or getting into a samurai sword fight. Whatever the case may be, Ninja Robbers has you covered.

- 12 skins
- Ninja-themed
- Great for roleplay!
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from 5 Frame Studios.

items.title: Modern Style
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Looking for a fresh modern style? Fear not! Modern Style is here, including 10 unique skins with all different colors and stylish clothes!

- 10 skins
- Fresh style
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from 5 Frame Studios.

items.title: Alien Squads
items.creator: House of How
items.description:
Alright folks, listen up! We’ve got aliens on board! And these ain’t the cute, cuddly kind. No sir. These are the tear your arms off kind.
There seems to be twenty-four different kinds of them, every one of them more dangerous than the last!
So grab your gear and get ready for these alien squads before they overrun us all!

items.title: Let's Get Lost
items.creator: House of How
items.description: Deep in the woods where will-o-wisps play and whispered voices echo you will find friendly faces peeking out from masks. “Come play with us,” they sing from the shadows, “let’s play hide and seek. Let’s play blind man’s bluff. Let’s play… forever.” Play along and get lost among 8 cult classic skins, before the masks come off.

items.title: Caffeinated Colors
items.creator: House of How
items.description:
Craving a cup of java? Need your morning joe? Jitter juice? Some brew? High octane? Wakey juice? Morning jolt? Bean juice? Cupped lightning? Liquid energy? A caffeine infusion? Brain juice? Some rocket fuel? Some worm dirt?
These wild, high quality skins bring a colorful spin to your “go juice” cravings! Check ‘em out!

items.title: Elemental Bots
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Put your wand and staff on the shelf and control the elements as a robot!

- 6 sci-fantasy HD skins
- Includes: Fire Bot, Water Bot, Earth Bot, Thunder Bot, Wind Bot, and Light & Dark Bot!
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from The Pocalypse Studios.

items.title: Dream Team Teens
items.creator: Ready, Set, Block!
items.description:
The dream team is ready to rock and roll! These teens have been practicing their Minecraft skills to see who the best player is. Choose your team and prepare for combat! Will you be the hunter or the hunted?

+ 12 dream team teens
+ 2 free skins 
+ By Ready, Set, Block!
